item.title: Nvidia halves Ohio OpenAI backstop to under $120bn: Why it happened, and why it matters
item.summary: Nvidia has cut the financial guarantee underpinning OpenAI's proposed Ohio data centre project from a discussed $250bn to less than $120bn, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. The post Nvidia halves Ohio OpenAI backstop to under $120bn: Why it happened, and why it matters appeared first on Capacity .
